### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
Default: **four off; radial exact on**. Set the five scheme variables before process startup. The helper `get_env` itself is not cached; each scheme accessor
caches its parsed boolean in a function-local static. Changing the environment after first use does not change that accessor.
An A/B comparison therefore needs a fresh child process per arm.
:::

| value, compared after lower-casing | WB / XC / FC / MC | radial exact |
|---|---|---|
| unset | off | on |
| empty string | off | on |
| `0`, `false`, `off`, `no` | off | off |
| every other string | on | on |

There is no trimming or validation of spelling: `false ` is on. Every block in one process sees the same cached value;
the code does not by itself make different MPI processes agree.

### Derivation

No numerical equation is added. Read the environment string, substitute the accessor default only when absent,
lower-case it, compare with the false tokens, and cache the result. The empty string is deliberately excluded from
radial exact's false set. `configuration_check.py` enumerates this truth table and the centroid implication.

### Numerical method

Launch child A with its environment, evaluate its first accessor call, then run all its blocks with that cached flag.
Launch child B separately. The first call can occur during setup before a time step, so changing a flag between RK stages
is not a valid experiment.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch12-environment-flow
#| fig-cap: "Environment parsing and process lifetime: labelled boxes show inputs and decisions in evaluation order. This is a configuration or stencil diagram, not measured data."
#| fig-alt: "parent sets environment; child A first read; cached A for all blocks; child B: fresh read."
#| echo: false
from snapy_report.ch12.fig_environment_flow import make_fig
make_fig()
```

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
The independent parser check models the documented contract; it does not execute the C++ static storage.
Cross-rank consistency is a launch responsibility. Unknown strings silently enable these switches.

The complete switch inventory is @sec-ch12-matrix.
:::
